commit: c1e31bb8 (repair pass, FINAL geometry; supersedes both the b2abed4d/ec0e33d7 capture and the intermediate 4c78e05c one)
judgeset: docs/raid-rebuild/SPATIAL_PLAN.md section 5, in authored order; ids mirrored in scripts/qa/viewpoint-catalog.mjs
note: These are the sanctioned harness's own frames (its .s1/.s2 persistence samples are left in the git-ignored artifacts/raid2/judgeset-repair/ run directory). All ten are under the 600 KB tracked-evidence ceiling, so none was resized. Served from this worktree's own `vite preview` of dist-vr-repair on 127.0.0.1:41941 (--url), because the harness hardcodes 41931 and other lanes' worktrees are live on this machine.
whatChangedSinceTheFirstCapture: The lane skeptic showed the stone family rendering close to black - in the first raid2-courtyard.png a near-black mass filled the bottom third of the frame and the courtyard piers read as silhouettes rather than as cover. Two causes, both measured and both fixed: (1) `stone`, the family carrying every piece of hard cover on the map, was authored at 0x7b7466 = 0.457 Rec.709 relative luminance against the paving's 0.565, i.e. the arena's cover was DARKER than its floor, in direct contradiction of the readability rule stated in its own material header; it is now 0xa8a496 = 0.643, and fidelity test 22 asserts the rule so it cannot regress. (2) `scene.environment` is NULL on this route, so the flat ambient is the only light on a face the sun misses, and it was authored at 0.44; it is now 0.60 (inside the shipped envelope - rustworks-1v1 runs 0.72, gun-range 0.64) and slightly desaturated, with the key untouched at 2.62 so only the shadow side moved.

measuredEffect.metric: fraction of pixels below 0.10 Rec.709 relative luminance ('reads as black')
measuredEffect.note: Re-measured on the FINAL capture after the eye-clearance repair (raid2 wing glazing removed, courtyard fountain basin enlarged). Whole-frame near-black fractions on the final ten: courtyard 0.31%, estate-overview 0.11%, pool-deck-return 0.13%, upper-bedroom 0.00%, drive-balcony 0.06%.

stillOwed: This is a LAYOUT lane. The surfaces are flat untextured albedo and that is the declared scope split - the owner's sentence had two halves and the art half (Lane L) is shelved at his own instruction. What is fixed here is READABILITY, which is a layout property: you cannot judge cover you cannot see.
geometryCorrectionInTheseFrames: raid2-upper-bedroom (camera 8) and raid2-drive-balcony (camera 9) are shot from U1 and U3. In the first capture those were places NO PLAYER COULD STAND - three of the four upper rooms were sealed. Commit 9e3eecaf opened the three stairwells and scripts/qa/raid2-reachability.ts now measures all six upper regions at 100% reachable from the spawn table, so these two frames are now shot from ground a player can actually occupy. The final capture also carries the eye-clearance repair: `raid2 wing glazing` (13 of 13 measured violations) is gone and the courtyard fountain basin is a real 3.4 x 3.4 m reflector.
harnessFinding: Unchanged and still reportable: scripts/qa/capture-arena-viewpoints.mjs has no port-collision detection. It hardcodes `const PORT = 41931` and spawns its preview with --strictPort, so on a machine with several lane worktrees live it will silently drive whichever build is already on that port and report a confident FAIL against your arena. The exact fail-closed patch is in the lane report; the file belongs to another lane and was not edited here.
